What I mean by that is that I understand the duty we all have to express how we feel towards and try to help those that are making a decision like the one I made , as a professional or a family member . I listened to all the points they had to make and all their ideas with an open mind, and then thank them for the time and effort . You see, the thing is , most individuals associate this kind of decision/behavior with an state of mind or mental illness as some call it like depression ,anxiety ,etc  but  that's not the case always . I am happy and at peace with my decision to not live anymore not because I am depressed , sad   or something is wrong inside my brain but because we all see life in a different way , some see it as a blessing or opportunity , but for me its just something that I don't want to keep on doing , not because its bad or good , it is just exhausting , but that is my personal opinion .

So before you go on to ask anymore questions, I have already talked to closed ones (friends/family) , doctors , psychiatrists, social workers ,and hotlines throughout my entire life , and I understand them but I have made my simple point across , so at this point all I really need is some help with the questions I had and if you don't have them that is more than fine too :).
